_readme: Curated effect encodings. Only stated numbers; anything context-dependent is kind:unmodeled with a note. sourceText quotes the stated effect. provisional:true marks entries whose source vintage is not current-patch-verified (owned augment scrape). Keys: item:<slug> | eternal:<id>:major | eternal:<id>:<minor> | augment:<hero>:<catalog-id> (hero augments live in augments.json, same schema; ids join the pred.gg field evidence). Ability-scoped effects target kit slots (PRIMARY/SECONDARY/ALTERNATE/ULTIMATE), mapped from ability names at curation time. Conventions for augments: hit-conditional effects ("when it hits a Hero") are modeled because the sim already assumes casts hit; positioning/pickup/terrain conditions are unmodeled; "isolated"/"nearest enemy" amps are modeled because kill-window sims are 1v1 by construction; per-rank augment amp arrays use the mean (core ability power scaling now retains ranks); tick cadences fold into per-cast totals.
